# CraftLeaf & Stardust Studio (青叶星尘独立工坊)

> Privacy-first 100% client-side browser micro-tools, zero-telemetry open-source IDE & browser extensions, original Print-and-Play tabletop strategy games, and bilingual North American newcomer survival guides. Zero user files or secrets are ever uploaded to a server.

- Portal: https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/
- Short Root URL: https://963239327.github.io/
- Digital Storefront (27 Products & Lifetime Passes): https://stardustdemo.gumroad.com
- Playable Tabletop Showcase: https://stardustdemo.itch.io

## Free Client-Side Interactive Web Tools (0 Bytes Uploaded)
- [Passport & Visa 4x6" ID Photo Print Sheet Maker ($0.39 CVS/Walgreens + Anti-Overscan Safe Bleed)](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/tools/id-photo/): US 2x2", China 33x48mm, Schengen/UK 35x45mm, Canada 50x70mm, Japan 45x45mm on 300 DPI 4x6" sheet.
- [No-Signup Freelancer Invoice, Quote & Receipt PDF Studio](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/tools/invoice/): Instant commercial vector PDF invoices with QR payment links.
- [CardSheet Duplex Flashcard & Tabletop PnP Aligner](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/cardsheet/): Sub-millimeter back-side mirror X/Y offset calibration and guillotine crop marks.
- [Star Chef Showdown — Free Browser Rondel Bistro Strategy Game](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/play/): Playable solo vs. AI funnel for our 7-game single-sided Print-and-Play tabletop lineup.
- [7 Original 2-Player Print & Play Strategy Board Games (Including 4 Ultra-Minimalist 2-Page Standard Poker-Deck Duels)](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/seo/2-page-poker-deck-print-and-play-board-games-for-2-players.html): *Tidal Trade League*, *Duchy of Firenze*, *Stargate Jump*, *Grand Curio Museum* (2 sheets + 1 54-card poker deck, zero coins, zero dice) plus *Woodland Seasons*, *Star Chef Showdown*, and *Cloudspire Alchemy* with 7 free sample PDFs.
- [WA Driver License Road Test 36 Examiner Audio Flashcard Trainer](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/tools/us-life/wa-road-test-trainer/): Interactive English audio command trainer for Washington State driving skills test.
- [US Doctor Visit & Urgent Care English Nurse Triage Symptom Card Maker](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/tools/us-life/doctor-symptom-card/): 100% local bilingual symptom, pain scale, allergy & free Mandarin interpreter request card generator.
- [US Credit Card Statement Closing Date vs. Due Date & <9% FICO Simulator](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/tools/us-life/credit-score-simulator/): Calculates exact pre-statement payment day & amount for newcomers starting from $500 secured cards.
- [2026 US Black Friday 4-Layer Cashback & Sales Tax Stacking Calculator](https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/tools/us-life/black-friday-calculator/): Separates pre-tax Rakuten cashback base from post-tax Amex/Chase Offer thresholds.
